auth.description:
To obtain your AiAnswer API access token, follow these steps below:
      1. Log in to your AiAnswer account at https://app.aianswer.us .
      2. Navigate to Settings < API Key.
      3. Click on Copy icon to copy your existing Key or click on New API Key to create a new one.
      4. Copy the API Key and paste it below in "AiAnswer API Key".

gmailGetListOfAgents.name: gmailGetListOfAgents
gmailGetListOfAgents.description: get the lists of agents with Gmail

aiMetadata.description: Lists the available Gmail-connected AI Answer agents on the account, returning their IDs. Use this to discover a valid agent ID before initiating or scheduling a call (those actions require an agent ID). Takes no input; read-only and idempotent.

createPhoneCall.name: createPhoneCall
createPhoneCall.description: Create a phone call to customer from Agent

phoneNumber.description: Enter the phone number, along with country code, in format (e.g., +919876543210)

details.description: Optional details with key-value pairs (e.g., customer_id, priority)

aiMetadata.description: Immediately places an outbound phone call from an AI Answer agent to a destination phone number. Use when an agent should call a customer right now; for a future-dated call use the schedule call action instead. Requires a valid agent ID and an E.164-formatted number with country code (e.g. +919876543210); optional key-value details can be attached. Not idempotent — each call places a new phone call.

getCallDetails.name: getCallDetails
getCallDetails.description: Fetch Call details by Call ID

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves the details and status of a single phone call by its call ID. Use to check the outcome or metadata of a call previously created or scheduled. Requires the call ID; read-only and idempotent.

scheduleCallAgent.name: scheduleCallAgent
scheduleCallAgent.description: Schedule a call with an agent

executionTime.description: Time to schedule the call in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format.

timezone.description: Timezone of the scheduled call (e.g., Asia/Calcutta)

prospectDetails.description: Optional prospect details with key-value pairs (e.g., customer_id, priority)

aiMetadata.description: Schedules an AI Answer agent to place an outbound call at a future date and time. Use when the call should happen later rather than immediately (for an immediate call use the create phone call action). Requires a valid agent ID, destination phone number, an execution time in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format, and a timezone (e.g. Asia/Calcutta); optional prospect details can be attached. Not idempotent — each call schedules a new call.

getCallTranscript.name: getCallTranscript
getCallTranscript.description: Fetch the transcript of a call by Call ID

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves the conversation transcript of a completed phone call by its call ID. Use to read what was said on a call after it has finished. Requires the call ID; read-only and idempotent.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

nl.\n To obtain your AiAnswer API acce:
Om je AiAnswer API-toegangstoken te verkrijgen, volg deze stappen hieronder:

de.\n To obtain your AiAnswer API acce:
Um dein AiAnswer API Zugangs-Token zu erhalten, folgen Sie den folgenden Schritten:
      1. Melden Sie sich bei Ihrem AiAnswer-Konto unter https://app.aianswer.us an.
      2. Navigieren Sie zu Einstellungen < API Key.
      3. Klicken Sie auf das Symbol kopieren, um Ihren vorhandenen Schlüssel zu kopieren oder klicken Sie auf den neuen API-Schlüssel, um einen neuen zu erstellen.
      Kopieren Sie den API-Schlüssel und fügen Sie ihn unten in "AiAnswer API Key" ein.
